description: Defines the srs_resource_configuration structure and related enums and nested structures for configuring Sounding Reference Signals (SRS) in 3GPP NR (5G) systems, including parameters like antenna ports, symbols, frequency hopping, and resource validity checks.

classes.name: srs_resource_configuration
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for SRS resource configuration in 3GPP NR.

methods.name: has_frequency_hopping
methods.description: Checks if frequency hopping is enabled based on current parameters.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Validates the resource configuration parameters for consistency and correctness.
